title: Microsoft PowerBi Developer / Reporting Analyst
text: Microsoft PowerBi Developer / Reporting Analyst at u&u. Recruitment Partners (Brisbane, ; Contract/Temp; salary: not stated). Our client wishes to engage a Power BI Developer to undertake analysis of systems, business processes, data and interfaces to tackle business problems for the Inbound Supply & Procurement Team and to lead all aspects of assigned reporting including report setup, scheduling, standardisation, and modification of reporting solutions using Microsoft Power BI based on data that is largely sourced from SAP / SAP BW. The PowerBi Developer, under the direction of the Leader, Enterprise Data Solutions, will be responsible for analyzing and transforming data into meaningful reporting outputs to assist our Inbound Supply and Procurement Team in making business performance decisions. Responsibilities / Critical Deliverables Working under the direction of the Leader, Enterprise Data Solutions, the contractor’s responsibilities will be across the following areas: Lead all aspects of assigned reporting including report setup, scheduling, standardisation, and modification of reporting solutions using Microsoft PowerBI based on data that is largely sourced from SAP / SAP BW; Working with the internal team to upskill and share knowledge of PowerBI development best practice and tips and tricks; and Design and develop intuitive and visually appealing reports according to standards. This is not an exhaustive list of position responsibilities. Specific duties may vary over time Skills & Qualifications Minimum of 5 to 10 years’ previous experience in a similar role in a large and complex information technology organisation operating in asset intensive (Rail, Mining, Utilities, Transportation) industries is highly desirable; and Strong consulting skills are highly desirable. Specific Skills Demonstrable skills in similar roles with responsibility for the full software development lifecycle environment participating in requirements gathering / scoping, design, development, testing deployment and maintenance with PowerBI and SAP BW; Lead all aspects of assigned reporting including report setup, scheduling, documentation, changes and modifications of reports in Microsoft Power BI; Proficient understanding of Business Intelligence solutions: operational and analytical with a particular focus on SAP data; Undertake analysis of systems, business processes, data and interfaces to tackle business problems; Strong verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills; Self-motivated, proactive, detail-oriented, and can work independently as well as in a team environment; Experience leading meetings, and the creation of presentations, status reports, specifications document, and technical design documents; and Rail industry and/or asset intensive (mining, utilities, transportation) experience preferred. For more information please call Renee Clayton or Riley Osborne at u&u on 07 3232 9146, quoting reference number 11305. Alternatively, to submit an application, please click below. Please submit your resume in Word format only.
